key_insight: AdamX uses cosine similarity to adaptively scale gradient updates, with variance rectification to stabilize early training.
engineering_relevance: It is a drop-in first-order optimizer that can be integrated into existing training pipelines to improve convergence efficiency across models and datasets.
method: Compute update magnitudes using cosine similarity as an adaptive control signal.
Apply variance rectification to smooth optimization in the early epochs.
Keep the optimizer model-agnostic and scalable for standard training workflows.
evidence_signal: The paper reports empirical evaluation on benchmark datasets and architectures, measuring how many epochs are needed to reach preset performance thresholds under a fixed hyperparameter budget.
watch_item: The method’s benefits may depend on careful tuning of the fixed hyperparameter budget and the early-stage variance rectification settings.
paper_title: AdamX: Cosine similarity meets gradient descent
